say:1:1441110001:1.text: One day, I was wandering outside the Lunaris Altar, lost in thought. It was shortly after I joined the guard.
say:1:1441110001:1.source_cn: 那是在我当上卫队成员不久后，因为某些事情，在银月祭庭外徘徊。

say:2:1441110002:1.text: I planned to confide in one of the priests about my troubles, but those at the altar just whisked past me without a word.
say:2:1441110002:1.source_cn: 我听说有困惑痛苦之事可以向祭司倾诉，但祭庭的祭司们行色...

say:3:1441110003:1.text: I sat on a bench for what felt like ages, until someone finally approached me.
say:3:1441110003:1.source_cn: 我在一张长椅上坐了很久，直到另一个人向我搭话。

say:4:1441110004:1.text: He asked me, a little nervously, if I had something to share.
say:4:1441110004:1.source_cn: 他有些紧张地问我，是不是有什么话想对别人说。

choice_prompt:5:1441110004.text: He asked me, a little nervously, if I had something to share.
choice_prompt:5:1441110004.source_cn: 他有些紧张地问我，是不是有什么话想对别人说。

say:6:1441110005:1.text: Feli wasn't a high priest yet at that time. He did his best to appear mature while talking to me.
say:6:1441110005:1.source_cn: 斐利尔那时还未成为高阶祭司，他努力装作大人模样与我搭话。

say:7:1441110006:1.text: In all seriousness, he declared, "As the youngest priest in Sal'thorin, it's my duty to empathize with your pain and help alleviate it."
say:7:1441110006:1.source_cn: 他认真地说，“身为萨洛克兰最年轻的祭司，我有义务感知并...

say:8:1441110007:1.text: I couldn't find the right words to explain, so I simply took him to that place.
say:8:1441110007:1.source_cn: 我张口却发现不知该从何说起。于是我带他去了那个地方。

choice_prompt:9:1441110007.text: I couldn't find the right words to explain, so I simply took him to that place.
choice_prompt:9:1441110007.source_cn: 我张口却发现不知该从何说起。于是我带他去了那个地方。

say:10:1441110008:1.text: It was... the grave of a Sinned One I had once slain.
say:10:1441110008:1.source_cn: 是被我亲手消灭的……孽化之人的坟墓前。

say:11:1441110009:1.text: Feli was surprised to see the grave, but he wasn't afraid.
say:11:1441110009:1.source_cn: 斐利尔看着坟墓，惊讶却并不害怕。

say:12:1441110010:1.text: So, I started letting it all out...

say:13:1441110011:1.text: About the Sinned One who mercilessly tore into their kin, the victim who cried and begged me to spare the culprit, and myself, who coldly delivered the final blow...
say:13:1441110011:1.source_cn: 无情撕咬亲人的孽化者，哭泣哀求我放过孽化者的被撕咬者，...

say:14:1441110012:1.text: Feli's eyes were closed, and his head was lowered. I think he was silently praying to the Queen.
say:14:1441110012:1.source_cn: 斐利尔闭上眼睛，低着头，看起来像是要向女王默默念诵祷词。

say:15:1441110013:1.text: In the end, he just conjured a bouquet of purple forget-me-nots and placed them at the grave.
say:15:1441110013:1.source_cn: 但最后他只是用魔法变出一束紫色的莫忘草，放在了那位艾塞...

choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 不会是什么危险的地方吧

choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 萨洛克兰最年轻的高阶祭司？
